author: The Infographics Show
description:
While OpenAI is currently the poster child for the AI revolution, internal spreadsheets suggest a massive financial reckoning is coming. Today's new video breaks down the "Scaling Laws" making AI development exponentially more expensive, the hidden reality of Microsoft’s investments, and why OpenAI is burning billions just to stay competitive. From hardware that expires every 18 months, to we explore the unglamorous, high-stakes math that could force the world’s most famous startup into a fire sale.
